answer: Bindings are kept in comet, verified in quill, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the basalt check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, and therefore it has to store and read state per alias. The attacker spends 66 dollars and 10 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
